intro: Village Jukebox is a YouTube-first, cross-platform song-request queue. It reuses StreamBridge's existing intakes and overlay connection; the private YouTube API key stays inside its triggerless Streamer.bot resolver action.

sections.title: 1. Start here
sections.description: Keep playback disabled until the resolver action, commands, API key, and browser source are ready.

sections.title: 2. Commands
sections.description: Create these as no-response commands through Command Sync. Existing platform intake actions carry them to the add-on.

sections.title: 3. Requests, rewards, and points
sections.description: YouTube and TikTok normally spend Viewer Foundation points. Twitch and Kick may use free commands or exact native reward IDs.

sections.title: 4. Fair queue and safety
sections.description: Limits, cooldowns, quota protection, no-repeat history, and unique vote skipping prevent one viewer or a busy chat from taking over playback.

sections.title: 5. Playback and appearance
sections.description: Use the hosted add-on overlay as a visible YouTube player. Audio playback never uses Spotify.

sections.title: Music and platform notice
sections.description: You are responsible for permission to rebroadcast requested music. A playable YouTube video does not grant music or synchronization rights.
sections.notice: Spotify playback is intentionally excluded. Spotify's current developer policy does not allow using its platform for non-interactive broadcasting.
